mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, username, email, type, title, content, image_count, status, reply, reply_time, create_time, update_time FROM feedback ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT id, user_id, username, email, type, title, content, image_count, status, reply, reply_time, create_time, update_time FROM feedback ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, username, email, type, title, content, image_count, status, reply, reply_time, create_time, update_time FROM feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, username, email, type, title, content, image_count, status, reply, reply_time, create_time, update_time FROM feedback WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, username, email, type, title, content, image_count, status, reply, reply_time, create_time, update_time FROM feedback WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback (user_id, username, email, type, title, content, images, image_count, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{email}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images, jdbcType=BLOB}, #{imageCount}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, images = #{images, jdbcType=BLOB}, image_count = #{imageCount}, status = #{status}, reply = #{reply}, reply_time = #{replyTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE feedback SET reply = #{reply}, status = #{status}, reply_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
